title: Tire Balance & Four-Wheel Alignment
subtitle: Shake, pull, and feathered wear — know driveway checks vs shop machine work.
tone: Production EN coach (US/EU): warm mentor, visual-first, max 2 CTAs, progress %, mileage personalization, legal disclaimer every step, high-risk modal with Find a nearby shop cancel, step feedback Yes/No. Phase 3 alignment: DIY inspect only; balance/align are shop machines.

prerequisites: Cold tire pressures set to placard
parts_checklist: None for DIY — shop: weights, alignment printout

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Staggered setups limit cross-rotation — alignment and balance still matter a lot.
Trucks that tow or run dirt roads eat alignments — inspect inner shoulders often.
EV weight amplifies inner edge wear — keep PSI exact and align sooner if pull appears.

risk_confirm.title: Shop service still requires a safe vehicle
risk_confirm.body: Do not drive to a shop on severely cupped or corded tires. If vibration is violent at highway speeds, reduce speed and find a nearby shop sooner — continuing can lose control.
